requirements.text: The system shall operate with the following Web browsers: Microsoft Internet Explorer versions 5.0 and 6.0, Netscape Communicator version 4.7, Netscape versions 6 and 7, and FireFox.
The System shall operate on Certified and Accredited servers running the current corporate approved versions of operating systems as appropriate.

The Data Management portion of the system shall permit user access from the corporate Intranet and, if a user is authorized for outside access through the corporate firewall, from an Internet connection at the user’s home.
The Data Research and Reporting portion of the system shall provide public access to reviewed and approved data sets.
The system shall use the current corporate standard Microsoft SQL Server database engine.
The system shall be in compliance with all Accessibility, Web Design, and Security policies applicable.
The system must be available to the intended audience 24 hours per day, 7 days a week with, 99% availability and a tolerance of -5% (not less than 50% of working hours in any week).
The system shall implement security controls in accordance with NIST SP 800-53 moderate baseline requirements.
The system shall maintain 99% availability, calculated as (Total Uptime / Total Scheduled Uptime) per month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
All data in transit shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher, and all sensitive data at rest shall be encrypted using FIPS 140-2 validated modules.
The system shall enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative and data uploader (UCC-1, UCC-2, UCC-3) accounts.
The system shall maintain 99.0% availability, measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced at least 48 hours in advance.
The system shall retrieve datasets up to 1GB in size within 10 minutes under a load of 50 concurrent users.
The system shall implement automated checksum validation and retry logic for all data transfers to ensure data integrity and reliability without manual intervention.
The system shall support an initial storage capacity of 500GB with a scalable architecture capable of expanding to 10TB over 5 years.
Define specific latency targets, such as: 'The system shall return search results for metadata queries in under 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent users.'
Specify the expected total data volume over a 5-year period to ensure appropriate storage architecture and backup strategies.
Define a concrete performance baseline or a maximum page load time (e.g., 'The main dashboard shall load in under 3 seconds over a standard T1 connection').
Clarify the availability target: 'The system shall maintain 99% uptime, excluding scheduled maintenance windows, calculated on a monthly basis.'
